map.//: TODO(design): working values (Big World, GAME_DESIGN.md §5.1–5.3, 2026-11-07: movement 8, sight 5, radius 40; before: 6, 3, 20). landmarkSightRange: landmarks this many hexes away or closer are seen even through rock. echoRange: an echo is heard when a place or patch not yet seen is this many hexes away or closer.

view.//: The map's Near and Far views (GAME_DESIGN.md §5.9): its zoom, 1 = the usual size on a computer, where about 21 hexes fit across the screen. The wheel and two fingers zoom between 0.4 and 3.

fastLanes.//: TODO(design): working values (GAME_DESIGN.md §5.2). currentCost: movement for a step with a current (0 = it carries her for free). corridorCostShare: a step along an old corridor costs this share of its ground's usual cost (0.5 = half, so mud costs 0.5 and salt 1.5).

field.//: TODO(design): M4, the surface's ground (surface.json). Water is the river there.

undergroundGenerator.//: TODO(design): working values (GAME_DESIGN.md §9). Distances in hexes. Ranges like [2, 4] mean from 2 to 4, picked at random for each world. Weights like { "remains": 40, "shrine": 20 }: bigger comes up more often. rings go from the lair outward; a ring's thresholds lead to the next ring. thresholdSpacing: thresholds of one border lie at least this share of the circle apart (0.2 = a fifth). outerEdge: distance from the rings' middle to the ring's outer edge before it wobbles (it is squeezed where the map is too small). seenRarePlaceChance: a rare place the world remembers from an earlier generation comes up with this share of its chance (§9.4); a biome location seen before is picked only when its biome has no unseen one left. Biomes and their ground are in biomes.json; thresholds, places, remains and run modifiers in world.json.

corridors.//: narrowShare: share of corridors one hex wide (the others are two). extraLinkShare: corridors beyond the minimum that make loops, as a share of the minimum. winding: how much corridors wander (0 = straight).

fastLanes.//: TODO(design): working values (Big World, GAME_DESIGN.md §5.2). Currents: this many per world, each this many hexes long, laid along the water of these biomes; a step with the current costs map.fastLanes.currentCost. Old corridors: the narrow tunnels between the chambers of these biomes; a step along one costs map.fastLanes.corridorCostShare of the ground's usual cost.

alert.//: TODO(design): perHexDiscovered and perBattle are working values (perHexDiscovered 0.2 until the Big World, 2026-11-07: four times the map and sight 5). Since M3 a battle raises the Alert less, and its messenger more if he gets away (order.json messengers).

battle.//: TODO(design): working values. The board is counted in hexes: boardColumns across, boardRows down (both odd, so the body has a middle hex). The body covers 7 hexes.

healing.//: TODO(design): working values. HP healed at End Turn, until the lair exists (M2).
